group_size.en: Groups of three; rotate BHW, resident and observer.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan; magpalit bilang BHW, residente at tagamasid.

purpose.en: Practise listening, factual recording and a clear next step within the BHW role.
purpose.fil: Magsanay sa pakikinig, tamang pagtatala at malinaw na hakbang sa saklaw ng BHW.

materials.fil: Lokal na impormasyon sa suporta/referral na aprubado ng trainer

steps.en: Trainer models a rushed encounter, then respectful listening. Ask learners what changed.
steps.fil: Ipakita ang minadaling usapan, saka magalang na pakikinig. Ipatukoy ang kaibahan.

steps.en: A resident answers briefly while a neighbour listens nearby.
steps.fil: Maikli ang sagot ng residente habang nakikinig ang kapitbahay.

steps.en: Ask permission, use an open question, listen, clarify and summarize. Use approved information and refer questions beyond training.
steps.fil: Humingi ng pahintulot, magtanong nang bukas, makinig, linawin at ibuod. Gumamit ng aprubadong impormasyon at i-refer ang lampas sa pagsasanay.

steps.en: Write a fictional handoff, explain the next step and invite the resident to explain it back. Rotate; give specific feedback and repeat.
steps.fil: Gumawa ng kathang handoff, ipaliwanag ang hakbang at ipasabi itong muli. Magpalit; magbigay ng tiyak na puna at ulitin.

debrief.en: Which phrase encouraged speaking? What was confirmed and what needs checking?
debrief.fil: Aling pananalita ang nakatulong magsalita? Alin ang tiyak at dapat pang suriin?

observe.en: Asks permission and an open question; lets the person finish.
observe.fil: Humihingi ng pahintulot at nagtatanong nang bukas; hinahayaang matapos ang kausap.

observe.en: Separates reports, observations and uncertainty; writes facts for an authorized recipient.
observe.fil: Hinihiwalay ang ulat, obserbasyon at di-tiyak; nagtatala ng datos para sa awtorisadong tatanggap.

observe.en: Explains plainly and checks understanding without blame.
observe.fil: Payak ang paliwanag at sinusuri ang pag-unawa nang walang paninisi.

output.en: Fictional handoff and individual observation; no clinical-management grading.
output.fil: Kathang handoff at indibidwal na obserbasyon; hindi pagsusulit sa clinical management.

alternative.en: Run one station now and the other three later; a solo learner can practise aloud.
alternative.fil: Isang station muna at ang tatlo sa susunod; maaaring magsanay nang malakas ang nag-iisa.

worksheet.fil: Pahintulot / bukas na tanong / ulat / obserbasyon / di-tiyak / hakbang / teach-back

group_size.en: Groups of three; rotate BHW, resident and observer.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan; magpalit bilang BHW, residente at tagamasid.

title.fil: Suriin ang source at di-berbal na pahiwatig

purpose.en: Distinguish observed cues and verified information from assumptions.
purpose.fil: Ihiwalay ang naobserbahang pahiwatig at natiyak na impormasyon sa hula.

steps.en: Trainer looks at the door and pauses silently. Describe what was seen, then ask a respectful clarification instead of guessing emotion.
steps.fil: Tumingin ang trainer sa pinto at tumigil nang tahimik. Ilarawan ang nakita at magtanong nang magalang sa halip na hulaan ang damdamin.

steps.en: Compare fictional cards: an undated forwarded post and a dated official notice. Identify author, date, evidence and where to verify.
steps.fil: Ihambing ang kathang card: forwarded post na walang petsa at opisyal na abisong may petsa. Tukuyin ang may-akda, petsa, ebidensiya at pagtitiyakan.

steps.en: Explain what can be reported and what remains unconfirmed.
steps.fil: Ipaliwanag ang maaaring iulat at ang hindi pa kumpirmado.

debrief.en: Why is a gesture not proof of what someone feels?
debrief.fil: Bakit hindi patunay ng damdamin ang isang kilos?

observe.en: Uses clarification and separates observation from inference.
observe.fil: Naglilinaw at naghihiwalay ng obserbasyon sa palagay.

alternative.fil: Maaaring gumamit ng printed cards nang walang internet.

worksheet.en: Observed / inferred / clarification / author / date / verification source
worksheet.fil: Naobserbahan / palagay / paglilinaw / may-akda / petsa / pagtitiyakan

group_size.en: Groups of three; rotate BHW, resident and observer.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan; magpalit bilang BHW, residente at tagamasid.

purpose.en: Complete an accurate document and route it appropriately.
purpose.fil: Punan nang tama ang dokumento at ipadala sa angkop na tatanggap.

materials.en: Blank locally approved form and fictional case details
materials.fil: Blangkong lokal na aprubadong form at kathang detalye

steps.en: Trainer shows the fields and authorized recipient on a blank form.
steps.fil: Ipakita ng trainer ang fields at awtorisadong tatanggap.

steps.en: Give a fictional case with a missing date. Fill known information and flag the missing detail.
steps.fil: Magbigay ng kathang kaso na kulang ang petsa. Punan ang alam at markahan ang kulang.

steps.en: Exchange forms; check completeness and factual wording, correct errors and explain the handoff.
steps.fil: Magpalitan; suriin ang pagkakumpleto at tamang pananalita, iwasto at ipaliwanag ang pagpapasa.

debrief.en: What does the recipient need before acting?
debrief.fil: Ano ang kailangan ng tatanggap bago kumilos?

observe.en: Does not invent missing facts; writes accurately and selects the authorized recipient.
observe.fil: Hindi nanghuhula; tama ang datos at tatanggap.

output.en: Completed fictional form; no real patient data.
output.fil: Napunang kathang form; walang tunay na datos ng pasyente.

alternative.en: Use the worksheet fields if no local form is available.
alternative.fil: Gamitin ang fields ng worksheet kung walang lokal na form.

worksheet.en: Date / concern / source / facts / missing details / action / recipient / follow-up
worksheet.fil: Petsa / concern / source / datos / kulang / aksiyon / tatanggap / follow-up
